jobs.title: Music Community Ambassador | First Chair Programme
jobs.description: Help shape the future of music teaching in London Are you part of London’s music community and passionate about teaching? Join First Chair , Matchspace Music’s founding ambassador programme, and help bring Europe’s leading platform for music educators to musicians across London. We’re selecting six musicians to help launch Matchspace Music in the UK. You’ll connect with fellow musicians across the city, share what you’re hearing on the ground, and help us understand what independent music teachers need to build and grow their teaching practice. You won’t be handed a script to promote. You’ll help shape how we arrive in London, from the very first week. About Matchspace Music Matchspace Music is Europe’s leading platform for music educators. We help independent music teachers build a professional online presence, get discovered by students, manage their lesson offers and get paid, all in one place. Founded in Switzerland in 2020, we are home to more than 2,000 qualified teachers across over 100 instruments, with more than 2,100 international teachers registered ahead of our launch. We’re now bringing this to the UK, starting with London. What you’ll do As a First Chair ambassador, you’ll: Introduce Matchspace Music to musicians in your peer networks. Start conversations about teaching and the challenges of building an independent teaching practice. Share feedback from your community with the Matchspace Music team. Contribute your own perspective to help shape our UK launch. Work with the team to develop an approach that feels relevant and authentic to London’s music community. This is a six-month freelance engagement, working remotely for four hours per week , starting immediately. Hours can be planned around your studies or other commitments. What you’ll bring We’d like to hear from musicians who: Are actively connected to London’s music community. Care about music teaching and want to help improve how it works. AI Trainer - Video Annotation
jobs.description: AI Trainer - Video Annotation Remote | Independent Contractor Prove your skills. Get certified. Robotics AI is advancing rapidly, and high-quality video data helps intelligent systems better understand the world around them. We are inviting detail-oriented professionals to complete our certification process for potential robotics AI projects. ▌ What you will do As part of the certification process, you will demonstrate your ability to: Annotate short video clips by identifying objects, actions and events. Evaluate video quality, relevance and accuracy against established guidelines. Assess the clarity and plausibility of movements. Apply instructions consistently and identify potential quality issues. ▌ What you bring Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking. Strong written English and the ability to follow detailed instructions independently. A commitment to accuracy and consistency. No previous AI or robotics experience required. ▌ What the work looks like You may review short videos and be asked to tag objects or actions, rate video clarity or camera angles on a 1 to 10 scale, or assess whether movements are clearly visible and plausible. Please note: We currently have three projects open, and completing the certification process will allow us to evaluate which project may be the best fit for you.
